content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Beaumont

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates hold a bachelor's degree plus specific years of direct project-leadership experience. Review PMI's official eligibility matrix, then contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Beaumont-focused cohorts deliver the PMI-required formal education in an interactive classroom setting, with real-world examples and hands-on exercises designed for working professionals managing complex projects in petrochemical and industrial sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the boot camp, submit your official PMP application directly to PMI, documenting your experience and education. Pay the associated PMI exam fee at the time of application. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process and answer questions about required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and optional review sessions—to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your proctored PMP exam when you feel confident. Our instructors remain available to clarify challenging topics as you move toward test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, commit to the PMI's three-year renewal cycle by earning professional-development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, and on-the-job project management. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you build PDUs and stay current with evolving industry standards.
